comment: Source read at commit 2b2ad81. Pruners.cpp:151 subtracts 1 from the speed knob before passing it on, which is what makes 1 on the panel read as the writing rate rather than as a standstill; the maker marks the line 'dirty fix'. The head count is stored into an int at RingBuffer.hpp:82, so the continuous 1 to 4 knob takes effect in whole heads. A sixth output, DEBUG_OUTPUT, is declared with no configOutput and no PortWidget, so no cable can reach it. The head outputs carry sound whether or not the head count includes them; the count only selects what the mix sums.
